title: Cash Back Payout Times and Caps, Paloma Rewards
content:
Cash back redeemed from Paloma Rewards points is paid to the member's linked debit card within a number of Paloma business days set by the tier, and is limited per redemption and per trailing 12 months.

| Tier | Paid within (Paloma business days) | Most cash back one redemption may pay (USD) | Most cash back from redemptions in the trailing 12 months (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 5 | 25.00 | 50.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 5 | 50.00 | 75.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 3 | 100.00 | 150.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 3 | 200.00 | 300.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 2 | 400.00 | 600.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 1 | 800.00 | 1200.00 |

## Notes on the limits

- The payout period is counted in Paloma business days, not calendar days.
- The per-redemption limit applies to each redemption on its own; the 12-month limit applies to the total cash back the member receives from redemptions within the trailing 12 calendar months ending on the handling date.
- Hypothetical illustration: a member on Paloma Rewards Silver who has already received 60.00 USD of cash back in the trailing 12 months has 15.00 USD of the 75.00 USD limit left.
